title: Ocean Scene 5 — Big, Small and How Many

sentenceModels: The turtle is smaller than the whale.

adultSupport.focus: Prompt comparison language and counting without overloading the scene.
starterPrompts: How many little fish can you count?
expansionPrompts: Can you compare the whale and the turtle?
Tell me a sentence with big.
Tell me a sentence with four.

visualAudit: Very large whale on the left.
One turtle in the middle and one small seahorse on the right.
One purple starfish and one tall seaweed clump.
Strong size contrast for comparison work.
